verdict.rationale: Netlify ships an official CLI that deploys from the terminal, including an anonymous no-login deploy path. It also has a REST API that its docs describe as ideal for automating workflows, plus automatic Git-push deploys that a community user confirms work well. Missing for 10: explicit docs on CI/non-interactive use (auth tokens, CI provider setup, headless flags), and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API—ideal for automating workflows and integrating into your systems.
automated builds and deploys, and rewrites/reverse proxy support work great
